name: @minarvabiz/desktop
description: Minarva Biz Offline / Hybrid Windows application
author: Evertek IT Solutions

scripts.build:electron: pnpm run prepare:license && pnpm run prepare:update && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run prepare:license && pnpm run prepare:update && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.package:win: pnpm run prepare:icon && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
